subject: Renewal gateways: timeline, stakeholders & QBR windowing
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@omnicare.io>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@omnicare.io>
Cc: David Kim <david.k@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal gateways: timeline, stakeholders & QBR windowing

Hi Lena & Tom,

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to kick off the formal renewal/expansion coordination so we have a clear runway for the upcoming term amendment and capacity uplift. High level goals: keep your production latency SLOs stable during scale, add the +20% seat throughput you mentioned, and finalize term changes by the end of May.

Action items I'm proposing this week:
- Confirm the internal stakeholder list from OmniCare who will sign off on procurement/ops (security and procurement + exec sponsor).
- Lock a QBR slot in May for an exec readout + mutual action plan.
- Share the usage export (attached) and a draft SOW (attached) for internal review.

Proposed timeline (rolling):
- Week of Apr 26: stakeholder confirmation + initial legal touchpoint
- May 3–7: QBR prep, technical run-through with Soojin and David
- May 10–14: Exec-level QBR and sign-off window
- May 21: Target to push signed amendment and capacity reservation

Possible QBR windows (PDT):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–11:00
- Wed May 12, 14:00–15:00
- Thu May 13, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, pick a couple of alternatives and I'll circulate a calendar invite. I've CC'd David and Soojin to handle technical sizing and any runbook changes.

Attachments: OmniCare_Q1_usage_summary.csv (usage by project), Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf (draft, highlights capacity options).

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.s@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@omnicare.io>

Subject: Re: Renewal gateways: timeline, stakeholders & QBR windowing

Thanks Hannah — this looks good. A couple quick notes from our side:

Stakeholders to include on our side:
- Procurement: Priya Ranganathan (pri.r@omnicare.io)
- Security: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@omnicare.io)
- Ops/Platform: Tom Alvarez (copied)
- Executive sponsor: Veronica Sato (veronica.sato@omnicare.io)

QBR availability: Wed May 12, 14:00–15:00 PDT works best for Veronica and Tom. If you can hold that slot tentatively, we'll confirm Priya and Marcus next week.

One ask: can David and Soojin prepare a short delta runbook that describes how Redwood will maintain the KV cache and rollback plan during the +20% throughput ramp? That will help Marcus validate the security/ops checklist.

I'll review the attachments and loop in procurement if there are any initial redlines.

Best,
Lena Brooks
Head of Platform Operations, OmniCare
Lena.Brooks@omnicare.io
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.s@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Brooks <lena.brooks@omnicare.io>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@omnicare.io>

Date: 2027-04-25T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal gateways: timeline, stakeholders & QBR windowing

Lena — thanks for the quick reply and the stakeholder roster. Wed May 12 14:00–15:00 PDT is tentatively held on our side. I'll send a hold and follow up with a short agenda.

David & Soojin: can you put together the delta runbook and a 10–15 slide tech readout that covers:
- Expected token/throughput profile at +20% seats
- Prefix & KV cache strategy during rolling scale
- Fallback & model-variant routing policy (how we gracefully degrade to smaller variants under contention)
- Rollback/playback plan for customer traffic in case we see regression

Deliverable deadline: May 6 COB so Lena's security and procurement teams have time to review. Please include an ops contact who will be on the QBR call for runbook Q&A.

Lena/Tom: once we have the technical packet and a draft amendment, I'll route to Marissa for final commercial approval ahead of the May 21 target date.

Attachments: re-attached summary & draft SOW.

Thanks,
Hannah
